verdict.rationale: Square documents a first-party Disputes API ('Process Disputes'), which points to programmatic dispute handling. A general Webhooks overview also exists, but the pack only has titles and never shows dispute-specific events, evidence upload, or deadline handling. missing for 10: explicit chargeback/dispute webhook notifications, documented evidence-submission flow, due-date/deadline visibility, Dashboard-side dispute workflow for ops users, independent or hands-on corroboration.
